# Game Idea: Canvas Escape

**Concept**: A top‑down endless runner where the player pilots a ship through a field of moving asteroids.

**Controls**: Arrow keys or mouse to steer.

**Goal**: Survive as long as possible, collect fuel cells to extend playtime.

**Lose Condition**: Collision with an asteroid or depletion of fuel ends the game.

1: // Simple Canvas Escape game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
5: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
6: 
7: // Background stars
8: const stars = [];
9: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
10:   stars.push({
11:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
12:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
13:     radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
14:   });
15: }
16: 
17: // Sound assets
18: const soundMusic = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kevinschaul/space-game-assets@main/background.mp3');
19: soundMusic.loop = true;
20: soundMusic.volume = 0.2;
21: const soundFuel = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kevinschaul/space-game-assets@main/fuel.wav');
22: const soundCrash = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kevinschaul/space-game-assets@main/crash.wav');
23: let musicStarted = false;
24: 
25: // Player ship (triangle)
26: const ship = {
27:   x: canvas.width / 2,
28:   y: canvas.height - 50,
29:   size: 16,
30:   speed: 4,
31:   color: 'lime',
32: };
33: 
34: let keys = {};
35: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
36:   keys[e.key] = true;
37:   if (!musicStarted) {
38:     soundMusic.play();
39:     musicStarted = true;
40:   }
41: });
42: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
43: 
44: // Asteroids & fuel
45: const asteroids = [];
46: const fuels = [];
47: let asteroidTimer = 0;
48: let fuelTimer = 0;
49: let score = 0;
50: let fuel = 100; // seconds
51: let gameOver = false;
52: 
53: function spawnAsteroid() {
54:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
55:   asteroids.push({
56:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size) + size / 2,
57:     y: -size,
58:     radius: size / 2,
59:     speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
60:   });
61: }
62: 
63: function spawnFuel() {
64:   const size = 10;
65:   fuels.push({
66:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size) + size / 2,
67:     y: -size,
68:     radius: size / 2,
69:     speed: 1.5,
70:   });
71: }
72: 
73: function update(dt) {
74:   if (gameOver) return;
75:   // Player movement (triangle uses size, not radius)
76:   if (keys.ArrowLeft && ship.x - ship.size > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
77:   if (keys.ArrowRight && ship.x + ship.size < canvas.width) ship.x += ship.speed;
78:   if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.y - ship.size > 0) ship.y -= ship.speed;
79:   if (keys.ArrowDown && ship.y + ship.size < canvas.height) ship.y += ship.speed;
80: 
81:   // Background stars drift
82:   stars.forEach(st => {
83:     st.y += 0.5; // slow downward motion
84:     if (st.y > canvas.height) {
85:       st.y = 0;
86:       st.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
87:     }
88:   });
89: 
90:   // Spawn asteroids/fuel
91:   asteroidTimer += dt;
92:   fuelTimer += dt;
93:   if (asteroidTimer > 1000) { // every second
94:     spawnAsteroid();
95:     asteroidTimer = 0;
96:   }
97:   if (fuelTimer > 3000) { // every 3 seconds
98:     spawnFuel();
99:     fuelTimer = 0;
100:   }
101: 
102:   // Update asteroids
103:   asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
104:     a.y += a.speed;
105:     if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
106:     // collision with ship (triangle approx using ship.size)
107:     const dx = a.x - ship.x;
108:     const dy = a.y - ship.y;
109:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
110:     if (dist < a.radius + ship.size) { gameOver = true; soundCrash.play(); }
111:   });
112: 
113:   // Update fuels
114:   fuels.forEach((f, i) => {
115:     f.y += f.speed;
116:     if (f.y - f.radius > canvas.height) fuels.splice(i, 1);
117:     const dx = f.x - ship.x;
118:     const dy = f.y - ship.y;
119:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
120:     if (dist < f.radius + ship.size) {
121:       fuel += 20; // add fuel seconds
122:       soundFuel.play();
123:       fuels.splice(i, 1);
124:     }
125:   });
126: 
127:   // Decrease fuel over time
128:   fuel -= dt / 1000;
129:   if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
130:   score += dt / 1000;
131: }
132: 
133: function draw() {
134:   // Clear and draw space background
135:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
136:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
137:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
138:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
139:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
140:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
141: 
142:   // Stars (twinkling)
143:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
144:   stars.forEach(st => {
145:     ctx.beginPath();
146:     ctx.arc(st.x, st.y, st.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:     ctx.fill();
148:   });
149: 
150:   // Ship (triangle)
151:   ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
152:   ctx.beginPath();
153:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size);
154:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
155:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
156:   ctx.closePath();
157:   ctx.fill();
158: 
159:   // Asteroids (rocky look with slight shading)
160:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
161:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
162:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
163:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
164:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
165:     ctx.beginPath();
166:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
167:     ctx.fill();
168:   });
169: 
170:   // Fuel cells (glowing)
171:   fuels.forEach(f => {
172:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, f.radius);
173:     grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,215,0,0.9)');
174:     grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,215,0,0.4)');
175:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
176:     ctx.beginPath();
177:     ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
178:     ctx.fill();
179:   });
180: 
181:   // HUD
182:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
183:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
184:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
185:   ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, Math.floor(fuel))}`, 10, 40);
186: 
187:   if (gameOver) {
188:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
189:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
190:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
191:   }
192: }
193: 
194: let last = 0;
195: function loop(timestamp) {
196:   const dt = timestamp - last;
197:   last = timestamp;
198:   update(dt);
199:   draw();
200:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
201: }
202: requestAnimationFrame(loop);

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>
